descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S02 「main 上现成的 spec：切换器、Quick Dictation、/clinic 重定向、深链接刷新、每个模式的自定义模板和 Settings」 Existing specs on main: switcher, Quick Dictation, /clinic redirect, deep-link reload, custom templates and Settings per context

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-04） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 4；TFA-92599 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Tim's suite at e02167f (navigation.spec.ts, template-isolation.spec.ts), each with its own fixture

When Run the four tests by title

Then Exactly one Hospital and one Nursing Home button, no Clinic; Quick Dictation only in Hospital; the setting persists; /clinic/* redirects to the selected context; a /rounding/<id> deep link survives a reload; each context lists only its own custom template, with one care-setting write per switch; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in the specs (button counts, URL, settings:get appMode, toHaveCount(0) for the other context's template, modeWrites). The deep-link test proves only that the chart and session survive a reload, with no context check; S08/S11 do that.

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — a deep link to a chart survives a reload — expected
  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — offers only Hospital and Nursing Home and remembers the selection — expected
  • template-isolation.spec.ts [chromium] — custom note templates stay visible only in their care setting — expected
  • template-isolation.spec.ts [chromium] — Settings belongs to the list it was opened from, and a setting saved elsewhere is not written back — expected
